answer: Each new identity must spend one voyage ticket on the ivory ledger. A ticket is earned only by a client-verified voyage, stamped with an opal seal bound to the earner key; it is burned on use, so one ticket makes one identity. A rented ticket fails: its opal seal key mismatches the applicant, so the auditor burns the ticket and the 25-credit bond. The k-th fake needs a fresh ticket: 40 voyage work plus a fee of 10 plus 2 per hundred tickets issued, plus 25 bond, so the 1000th pays 93 and 1000 fakes pay 84000. An honest agent spends its own voyage ticket, locks 25 bond, and pays a 10 fee.
